QXO.headline: QXO is Set to Report Q3 Earnings: Here's What Investors Should Know
QXO.description: QXO is set to report Q3 2026 results on November 12, with revenues expected to surge 77.6% year-over-year to $4.9 billion, driven by TopBuild and Kodiak acquisitions. However, EPS is projected to decline 7.1% due to acquisition costs and higher interest expenses. The company has a Zacks Rank of 4 (Sell) with a negative Earnings ESP of -0.79%.

TTD.headline: Pre-Market in Green
TTD.description: U.S. futures opened higher Monday, recovering from last week's selloff. Energy companies NRG and Constellation Energy surged on strong Q3 earnings beats. However, NVIDIA shares fell 6% following reports of CEO Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a Chinese spy. The week ahead features Fed commentary, inflation data (CPI and PPI), and earnings from The Trade Desk, Take-Two Interactive, and Groupon.

TTD.headline: Jensen Huang News Dominates Morning Headlines
TTD.description: U.S. stock futures opened higher on Monday, November 9th, 2026, as markets recover from last week's selloff. NVIDIA shares fell 6% following reports about CEO Jensen Huang's personal conduct. Energy companies NRG and Constellation Energy posted strong Q3 earnings beats, with NRG up 7% and CEG up 2.8%. The week ahead includes Fed commentary, earnings from The Trade Desk and Take-Two Interactive, and key inflation data (CPI and PPI).

TTD.headline: The Trade Desk Stock Has Lost About 89% Since the End of 2024. Its Nov. 9 Report Is the Next Test.
TTD.description: The Trade Desk's stock has plummeted 89% since end of 2024, trading near $13 after an August forecast miss. The ad tech company guided for Q3 revenue of at least $650 million (down 12% YoY) and faces investor scrutiny as it has recently missed its own revenue forecasts. The company's Nov. 9 earnings report will be critical to determine if guidance credibility can be restored and whether revenue declines are stabilizing.

STRL.headline: URI Raises 2026 Revenue View by $450M: Can Mega-Projects Fuel Growth?
STRL.description: United Rentals (URI) raised its 2026 revenue guidance by $450 million to $18-$18.2 billion, driven by strong demand from mega-projects in infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and data centers. Third-quarter rental revenues grew 17.8% to $4.32 billion with 6.5% productivity gains, while specialty rentals surged 34.7% to $1.70 billion. The company increased capital expenditure guidance by $300 million and expects momentum to extend into 2027.

STRL.headline: Zacks Value Investor Highlights: MU, SNDK, SANM, STRL and FIX
STRL.description: AI stocks have experienced significant sell-offs in October and November 2026 despite strong earnings reports and raised guidance. Despite fears that the AI trade is over, several AI-related companies now trade at historically low valuations with strong growth prospects, presenting potential buying opportunities for value investors.

OKLO.headline: Oklo Is Down 86% From Its High. Will Shares Soar When Meta's Reactor Comes Online?
OKLO.description: Oklo, a small modular reactor (SMR) developer, has seen its stock plummet 86% from its high despite strong AI-driven demand for nuclear energy. While Meta has committed to a 1.2 GW SMR system with construction potentially starting in late 2028/early 2029, meaningful electricity generation isn't expected until 2030 at earliest. Rising capital costs, lack of NRC approval, and deteriorating AI sentiment pose significant risks to the project timeline and Oklo's financial viability.

OKLO.headline: Oklo: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
OKLO.description: Oklo outlined its strategy to build multi-reactor power fleets while commercializing fuel and isotope capabilities. Key highlights include plans to sell fuel fabrication capacity to third-party reactor operators as a standalone revenue stream, completion of Groves-1 test reactor construction in under a year, and securing component capacity for 27 Aurora reactor modules through 2035 via a long-lead supplier contract with U.S. Forged Rings.

RKLB.headline: Why Nov. 9 Could Be a Huge Day for Rocket Lab Investors
RKLB.description: Rocket Lab is set to report Q3 results on Nov. 9, 2026, which could be a major catalyst for its stock. The company's shares have declined 24% in 2026 and 64% from their all-time high due to reversed momentum in space stocks following SpaceX's IPO, defense industry valuation contractions, and political concerns. Investors will be watching for revenue exceeding guidance and gross margins at the higher end of the 35-37% target range to trigger a rebound.

IONQ.headline: Why IonQ Stock Plummeted 31.5% in October
IONQ.description: IonQ stock dropped 31.5% in October following the announcement of its $1.3 billion acquisition of Elisity and a $2 billion equity offering, which raised concerns about share dilution among investors. Two analysts also reduced their price targets on the stock. However, the stock has since recovered, rising over 18% in November after strong Q3 2026 earnings results.

IONQ.headline: IONQ Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Guidance Hike and Quantum Demand
IONQ.description: IonQ raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $505-$515M from $450-$460M, driven by 336% Q3 revenue growth to $173.83M. The company's Superion 256 capacity is fully booked for 2027 with orders extending into 2028. SkyWater integration contributed $83.5M in Q3 revenues, while IonQ Platform revenues grew 127% year-over-year. Management is focusing on manufacturing expansion, quantum security opportunities, and operational efficiency improvements.

IONQ.headline: 3 Millionaire-Maker Quantum Computing Stocks
IONQ.description: The article highlights three quantum computing stocks as potential high-risk, high-reward investments: IonQ, Quantinuum, and Rigetti Computing. IonQ leads with 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity and plans to release a 256-qubit system next year. Quantinuum recently achieved 99.9995% logical fidelity and aims for fault-tolerant quantum computing by 2029. IONQ.headline: Not IonQ. Not D-Wave. This "Boring" Blue Chip Stock Is Quietly Leading in Quantum Computing
IONQ.description: IBM is positioned as a quiet leader in quantum computing despite being a traditional blue-chip company. With a $10 billion commitment to its quantum roadmap, the world's largest fleet of quantum computers (90+ deployed), and its latest Nighthawk r2 processor offering 25x throughput improvements, IBM is expected to see measurable revenue impact by 2028-2029. CEO Arvind Krishna projects quantum computing could represent a trillion-dollar opportunity by the end of the 2030s.

APP.headline: Kaplan Fox Encourages Investors of AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTS) Who Suffered Losses to Contact the Firm Before November 13, 2026
APP.description: Kaplan Fox has filed securities class action lawsuits against AST SpaceMobile (ASTS), AppLovin (APP), and Bank of America (BAC) on behalf of investors who suffered losses. AST is accused of overstating its competitive advantages in the satellite D2C market and capital sufficiency. AppLovin's class period spans February to August 2026, and Bank of America's spans August 2025 to October 2026. Investors have until specified deadlines to seek lead plaintiff status.

APP.headline: Here is Why Growth Investors Should Buy AppLovin (APP) Now
APP.description: AppLovin (APP) is highlighted as a top growth stock pick due to its exceptional earnings growth of 61.2% (vs. 22.6% industry average), strong cash flow growth of 88.4% (vs. -2.7% industry average), and positive earnings estimate revisions. The company holds a Growth Score of B and Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), positioning it as a potential outperformer for growth investors.

APP.headline: AppLovin Shares Surge as Revenue Continues to Soar. Is It Too Late to Buy the Stock?
APP.description: AppLovin stock surged after delivering strong Q3 2026 results with revenue of $2.18 billion (55% growth) and EPS of $4.30 (76% growth), both exceeding analyst expectations. The company's AI-powered adtech platform continues driving growth in gaming and emerging consumer segments. Management projects Q4 revenue growth of 43-44% and maintains the stock remains undervalued at a forward P/E below 18x despite the recent rally.

CIFR.headline: IREN's $4B Revenue Goal Delayed: Is the Stock Losing Its Appeal?
CIFR.description: IREN Limited has pushed its $4 billion annualized run-rate revenue goal from end-2026 to January 2027 due to design changes and supplier delays. While AI cloud revenues surged 182% to $200M, the company posted a $263M net loss with rising operating costs. IREN faces a $6B funding gap for expansion beyond its initial program, raising concerns about execution and profitability despite a substantial $20.3B revenue backlog.

IREN.headline: Microsoft Is Reportedly Getting Pickier About AI Data Center Deals. Is the Stock a Buy Now?
IREN.description: Microsoft is tightening oversight of AI data center deals with neocloud providers like Nebius Group and Nscale, reportedly backing away from riskier projects. While this could reduce financial risk, the company's free cash flow has declined 23% year-over-year to $60 billion, and shifting focus to building its own data centers may worsen cash flow pressures in the short term. The analyst maintains that Microsoft's stock at $535 remains overvalued and would prefer entry closer to $465.
